name: Ogle Tanka Un
body:
Prerequisite(s): Counting coup class feature, any 1 Teamwork Feat (or Leadership)

Benefit(s): Each time an ally within 30 ft lands a killing blow on an enemy, you have a 50% chance to gain a coup point if they intentionally let out a loud war cry.

Origin: The term effectively means “War Leader” but literally means “Shirt Wearer.”
